title: Bubble Bath Song 🎶 #shorts #nurseryrhymes
description:
Sing along with us! 🎶

Lyrics :
Splash, splash, in the tub,
bubbles on my little nose,
splash, splash, rubadub!
and the duckie says quack quack!

Splash, splash, in the tub,
Ding is making great big waves,
splash, splash, rubadub!
Dang is laughing, ha ha ha!

Splash, splash, in the tub,
now we're out and towel dry,
splash, splash, rubadub!
clean and cozy, warm and snug!

Original song by Ding Dang Nursery Rhymes: original lyrics, music and animation. Synthetic voice: Piper ("lessac" voice).

#nurseryrhymes #kidssongs #singalong
